associations.rationale: The displayed type only exposes IsSimpleStep as a Prop-valued relation on two subrepresentations and a vertex, so its defining content is opaque.

For a positive root and an orientation of the Dynkin diagram, the formal type directly produces an indecomposable representation and a composition series whose multiplicity at each vertex is the corresponding root coordinate.
Under an ordering compatible with the arrows, the formal type directly produces a composition series and identifies each simple multiplicity with the representation's dimension vector.
The displayed type only introduces the type of quiver-representation composition series and does not state their existence or multiplicities.

This generic infrastructure theorem constructs a composition series with prescribed dimensions under an arrow-compatible ordering, serving as the helper construction rather than stating the positive-root claim itself.
